recentItems.title: A trait we would change...
recentItems.description: Anxiety? Follow through? People pleasing? What's a trait of yours that you wish you could change or improve upon?

recentItems.title: Got a second bedroom, guests all the time
recentItems.description: Skeery's finally moved into an apartment with two bedrooms, but he is regretting spreading the word.... apparently he's been flooded with unwanted houseguests ever since he moved in! Gandhi's right though, he's been advertising it himself! 😅

recentItems.title: Should Restaurants Be Allowed to Ban Kids Under 10?
recentItems.description: Skeery's in full support of restaurants banning children under a certain age! He thinks this peaceful dining option is an amazing idea, but the parent community may disagree... what do you think? 🤔

recentItems.title: One Man's Trash: The Craziest Stuff We've Found
recentItems.description: Scotty's garage is apparently filled with all sorts of "second-hand" (trashed) goods 😭 next time you need a children's step-stool or pogo-stick, you know exactly who to hit up!

recentItems.title: Secret Pogo Talents
recentItems.description: We need Scotty to bring his pogo stick in IMMEDIATELY and put Andrew's talents to the test 👀 the biggest question though is why Scotty owns this pogo stick...? 😭

recentItems.title: He Can't Even Say "Hello" Without Complaining First
recentItems.description: Starting each day with complaints cannot set a good trajectory for the rest of the day 😭 after realizing he lacks calmness throughout all aspects, Scotty's trying to rewire this habit!

recentItems.title: The Edible Dosing Mistake...
recentItems.description: Nate & Scotty's one wish is to sleep through the night... but at what cost? 😴 Gandhi's suggesting indica weed but that didn't go great for Nate last time! And now Andrew's mom's experience is making him second guess even more...

recentItems.title: Why Saying "No" Might Be the Way To Go
recentItems.description: As a chronic people pleaser, Skeery is trying to unlearn this habit and start saying "no" 🤔

recentItems.title: The Day We Blocked 200 Numbers
recentItems.description:
We’re talking about the extreme lengths people go to after catching a cheater, including one woman who blocked 200 numbers on her girlfriend’s phone! Plus, we debate songs we always skip, hear about Abby leaving food in the fridge, Skeery gets roped into his friends’ kids’ fundraisers, and play a round of the Speeding Ticket game.
